cards.name: Ohmen Surge

effects.printed_clause: You can only activate 1 "Ohmen Surge" per turn.
If your monster becomes co-linked, place 1 Current Counter on it.
effects.lua_implementation: An EVENT_ADJUST continuous effect flags each currently co-linked own monster, adds one counter once per co-linked interval, and clears its flag when it ceases to be co-linked.

official_references.matched_structure: Official co-linked group/state inspection; Current Counters and edge detection remain custom.

effects.printed_clause: When the opponent activates a Spell Card/effect while you control an "Ohmechanic": target an opponent monster, place it in a free Main Monster Zone pointed to by your co-linked monster, and take control.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_CHAINING checks opponent Spell activation/effect and an Ohmechanic, derives free zones from controlled co-linked monsters, targets a control-changeable opponent monster, and Duel.GetControl places it in the selected mask.

official_references.matched_structure: Official co-link zone discovery and movement component.

effects.issue: No official Omega card combines control change with compulsory placement into a co-linked pointed zone. The Lua components are structurally plausible, but the combined custom placement mechanic has no exact official reference.

cards.audit_note: Confirmed as an unresolved custom-reference gap, not a demonstrated Lua defect: official scripts cover co-link discovery and control change separately but not their zone-constrained combination.

coverage_override.reason: All printed procedures, continuous clauses, activated/triggered effects, branches, and attached once-per-turn restrictions are represented in the listed semantic effect records.
